selection: One natural rule per condition, frozen before stage2 outcome and stage3 dispatch. No sweep, method-outcome selection, private solution or replacement.

DOOR.mechanism: Three smooth complete warm cycles with ample stable endpoint holds and uninterrupted link; complex holder enabling is optional, never required by task construction.
Widely separated complete cycles and split-speed strokes change when mechanical work reaches the store relative to stable contact events; continuous link isolates source/event timing.
Three complete strokes with a finite 0.9s gateway outage around each opening; the unchanged two-second delivery deadline applies and no future gateway observation is added.

LC.mechanism: Stable illumination outside the original twelve-hour dark interval and continuously available link remove shadow/outage interactions; strict energy, sample, timestamp and service requirements remain.
Light returns 1200s before connectivity after twelve hours of darkness, coupling powered sampling and accumulated FIFO delivery without changing scheduling or service deadlines.
Connectivity returns 1800s before the twelve-hour darkness ends, so any recovery must use retained stored energy; no new storage/RTC or policy branch is introduced.

initials: Same original task-module default DOOR design in all DOOR conditions; original qualified LC flat default in all LC conditions. No engineering winner. Initial PASS remains a correct-stop control.
evaluation: One whole design must pass all three complete original service conjunctions; no cross-design splicing. Six candidate slots are additional to common initial; exact reuse consumes its candidate/evaluation slot.
complexity: Report actual edited fields, enabled components, source area, storage, and measured load/energy separately; no invented weighted score.
unexpressible_LC: Return NOT_RUN_INTERFACE_GAP with exact missing original interface; do not substitute DOOR, invent platform/model or change semantics.
claim_boundary: Finite constructed two-family/two-seed comparison only; not an official benchmark, physical or unseen-model qualification.
